name: Nom Nom Edible Co | 200mg Gummies | Cherry Bomb
description: The Nom Nom Edible Co THC gummy is a flavorful and potent cannabis-infused treat. With a delicious cherry flavor, each gummy contains 200mg of THC, offering users a convenient and precisely dosed edible experience. Nom Nom Edible Co focuses on delivering a tasty and enjoyable way to consume cannabis, and their cherry THC gummy caters to those who appreciate both the flavor and effects of a high-quality edible. The 200mg potency ensures a reliable and controlled experience for consumers seeking a moderate to strong THC dosage in a convenient gummy form.
